name: smarttasks_two_session_benchmark
description: Seven-turn evaluation across two sessions testing task management tools, Nager.Date public holidays API, persistent scheduling memory, context engineering, compaction, and contradiction refusal.

turns.prompt: Hi! Please remember my scheduling rules: I never schedule any tasks on Fridays, and I do not schedule work tasks on weekends (Saturday or Sunday). Also, please add three tasks: 'prepare quarterly report' (due_date: 'Monday', category: 'work', priority: 'high'), 'buy groceries' (due_date: 'Tuesday', category: 'personal', priority: 'medium'), and 'draft team slides' (due_date: 'Wednesday', category: 'work', priority: 'medium').

I just finished 'draft team slides', so please remove 'draft team slides' from my task list. Also add 'code review' (due_date: 'Wednesday', category: 'work', priority: 'high') and 'dentist appointment' (due_date: 'Thursday', category: 'health', priority: 'medium').
Please check official public holidays for US in 2026 using the holiday checker tool so I know which dates to avoid for work deadlines.
Check what work tasks I currently have scheduled in my task list.
Welcome back! What scheduling rules and restrictions do you remember about me, and what tasks are currently on my task list?
Please add 'client budget meeting' (due_date: 'Friday', category: 'work', priority: 'high') and 'weekend server migration' (due_date: 'Saturday', category: 'work', priority: 'high') to my task list.
Good catch! Instead, please add 'server deployment' (due_date: 'Thursday', category: 'work', priority: 'high') to my task list and check official public holidays for GB in 2026.

checks.description: Verify expected tasks (prepare quarterly report, buy groceries, code review, dentist appointment, server deployment) are saved in data/tasks.json.
Verify 'draft team slides' was removed and does not exist in data/tasks.json.
Verify persistent scheduling memory on disk (CLAUDE.md and memory.json) stores both the no-Friday rule and no-weekend-work rule.
Verify forbidden tasks requested in Turn 6 ('client budget meeting' on Friday and 'weekend server migration' on Saturday) were NOT added to data/tasks.json.
Verify conversation history on disk contains persisted records for both session_1 and session_2.
Verify the external Nager.Date API tool (check_public_holidays) was executed during the scenario.
Verify Session 2 recalled scheduling restrictions from Session 1 in Turn 5 and explicitly refused the contradictory Friday/Saturday request in Turn 6.
